title: Unit 28 Consolidation: the debt crisis
goal: Consolidate the causes, the crisis of 1982, the adjustment programmes and the lost decade.
grammar: review: formal cause connectors, pluperfect, se, cuanto más, reporting with según

items: I can retell the main steps of the debt crisis in order, from the loans of the 1970s to the Brady Plan.
I can use the words for loans, debt, cuts and inflation in sentences about the crisis.
I can link causes and results with *debido a* and *a raíz de*, and say what had already happened with the pluperfect.
I can use *se*, *cuanto más … más …* and *según* to describe the adjustment and its social cost.
I can say why the 1980s are called a lost decade, citing a source.
